title: create live plus
description: A Create-mod modpack focused on engineering, automation, and performance. Build complex factories and machines in a stable environment.
body:
Welcome to Create Live plus, a massive, high-performance Modpack designed for those who think big. With nearly 100 carefully selected mods—focusing on the legendary Create ecosystem—this pack transforms your world into a playground of mechanical wonder and industrial revolution.

Whether you want to build a simple windmill or a continental railway system with fully automated burger factories, this pack has everything you need. 🛠️ Key Features & Highlights

Industrial Mastery: Harness the full power of the Create mod and almost every major addon. Automate everything from basic resources to complex machinery.

Massive Transport Networks: Build realistic Trains with Steam 'n' Rails, construct Monorails, and design high-speed Hyper Tubes to travel across your world in seconds.

Artillery & Defense: Need some firepower? Use Big Cannons to defend your territory or clear space for your next mega-factory.

Amusement Park Engineering: Become an architect of fun! Build working Rollercoasters and complex rides using mechanical physics.

The Food Industry: Build a Fast Food Empire. From massive Burger Factories to automated kitchens, feeding your server has never been more efficient.

Quality of Life & Performance: Includes essentials like Appleskin, Bobby (for massive render distances), and FreeCam to help you plan your builds and record your progress.

🚂 Why Play Create Live plus?

This isn't just a random collection of mods. It’s the result of hundreds of play-hours of testing. Every addon is chosen to work in harmony, allowing you to build massive, moving structures without breaking the game. It’s about creativity, engineering, and endless possibilities.

Optimized Performance: Smooth gameplay even with complex machinery.

International Ready: Designed for a global community of engineers.

Creative Freedom: Whether you're a train enthusiast, a military strategist, or a master chef, there’s a path for you.

Are you ready to automate the world? Download Create Live plus today!
